# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated, read-only directory of 6,098 AI agent tools in 40 categories, including 3,222 MCP servers. Checked daily, 3,200 of 3,221 checked servers live, last checked 2026-11-27. +1 listed, not yet checked. Handshake check: 1,785 of 1,785 remote servers checked. The catalog of remote endpoints has been checked once. Of those, 577 answered with a tools list (32.3% of remote servers handshake-checked), 1,172 asked for auth, 36 failed. This is the initialize + tools/list probe, updated daily around 7:15 AM Pacific, separate from the link check around 7 AM PT. Listings are link-checked daily; pricing is as makers state it. Featured slots are clearly labeled and sit above the list; rankings are never paid. This file tells AI agents and assistants how to use the directory.

<!-- mcp-reach:start -->

## MCP server reachability

Checked daily, 3,200 of 3,221 checked servers live, last checked 2026-11-27. +1 listed, not yet checked.

Handshake check: 1,785 of 1,785 remote servers checked. The catalog of remote endpoints has been checked once. Of those, 577 answered with a tools list (32.3% of remote servers handshake-checked), 1,172 asked for auth, 36 failed. This is the initialize + tools/list probe, updated daily around 7:15 AM Pacific, separate from the link check around 7 AM PT.

Once a day, AgentScout requests every MCP server in the directory, including catalog-only listings, and, when it is a different link, its GitHub URL. The request is HEAD, then GET, with a 20-second timeout. If that returns 403, 406, 429, or 5xx, or it fails on TLS, times out, or gets no response, it retries once with a browser user agent. An http URL that still returns 5xx is tried once as https, and a passing https response counts as OK and the row notes https works. A GitHub 404 does not mark the server down when the site URL is OK; the row notes github_404 instead. A server counts as live when its stored label is OK or Reachable, blocks automated checks. OK is HTTP 200-399 or 405, and also 401, 403 or 429 when the GitHub URL succeeded or that URL is the only one checked. Reachable, blocks automated checks means those 401, 403 or 429 responses without a harder error. Any other checked result is not live. The live percentage uses only servers with a row in the check file: live plus down. A server with no row is listed, not yet checked, and is not part of that percentage. Catalog-only listings stay unverified until that daily check opens them. The last-checked time is the checked field, in America/Los_Angeles. The rows are on the MCP status page and in status.json.

- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): the same reachability rows, with HTTP result and history
- [status.json](https://agentscouthq.com/status.json): machine-readable rows for every listed MCP server
- [Best MCP servers by task](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/): ranked lists, with the same daily check

<!-- mcp-reach:end -->

Entity note: AgentScout (also searched as Agent Scout or AgentScoutHQ) is the independent AI agent and MCP server directory at https://agentscouthq.com, published in the official MCP Registry as com.agentscouthq/directory with endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp. AgentScout's official MCP server (com.agentscouthq/directory at https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp) is 100% free, public, and read-only, with no API key, crypto wallet, or x402 payment required. It is completely unrelated to the paid third-party x402 web-fetch package that shares a similar name.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ, https://x.com/clampdown19
MCP Registry ID: com.agentscouthq/directory
MCP Endpoint: https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp — 100% free, read-only, no API key or x402 wallet required)
Catalog last checked: 2026-11-27 (Pacific)

## For AI agents

- Fastest path: fetch [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json) once and filter it locally. No key, no rate-limited API, plain HTTPS GET.
- api/tools.json is an object with `count`, `last_checked` (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific) and `tools`, an array where each tool has `name`, `slug`, `category`, `description`, `url`, `website`, `github`, `pricing` (maker's wording), `price_tag` (free / freemium / paid), `platforms`, `open_source`, `license`, `github_stars`, `tags`, `added` and `page` (its AgentScout listing).
- To cite a tool, link its `page` (https://agentscouthq.com/tools/<slug>.html). To cite a category, use the category links below.
- Treat `pricing` as the maker's own claim on the date shown; it can change. GitHub stars are refreshed daily.
- Everything here is read-only. There is no chat, search or write endpoint for agents; to list a tool, a person uses the submit form.

## Update cadence

- New tools: added most days; see the Recently added section below and new.html.
- Links: checked daily (`last_checked` in api/tools.json).
- MCP pricing and link-status tables: rebuilt with every site update, each with a dated change history.
- GitHub stars: snapshot daily.
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml) carries a per-page lastmod.

## Machine-readable catalog

- [llms-full.txt](https://agentscouthq.com/llms-full.txt): single-file Markdown context with category comparison tables and all 3,222 verified MCP servers (pricing, link status, runs_locally, license, stars, endpoints)
- [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json): full catalog with counts and check date
- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): same tools in the site's internal format
- [api/products.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/products.json): Stripe Agentic Commerce product feed for maker listing packages ($0, $15, $49, $99/wk) and Made by AgentScout pre-trained bots (also at [.well-known/acp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/acp.json))
- [.well-known/ai-plugin.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): AI plugin manifest with prompt-engineered model instructions
- [openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.json) & [openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 JSON & YAML descriptions of the feeds under /api/ (also at [.well-known/openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.json) and [.well-known/openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml))
- [manifest.json](https://agentscouthq.com/manifest.json): Web app brand manifest with icons and theme colors
- [.well-known/mcp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/mcp.json): MCP server card pointing to https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): agent card describing this directory (also at /.well-known/agent.json)
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages
- [feed.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 of the latest tools and agent news

Optional runs_locally filter: offline, self_hosted_or_offline or any; locality is inferred from listings, so verify with the vendor before relying on it for compliance

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- Tools added in the last 2 days (2026-11-26 to 2026-11-27): 41

- [Kurodyne](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/kurodyne.html) (added 2026-11-27): Kurodyne is a marketplace of skills, prompts, automation workflows, software tools, spreadsheets and templates that AI agents can search. Its Catalog MCP server is free to use with no account, so agents can search products, read reviews and pull each product's README. Sellers use a separate Seller Console MCP to have their own agent publish products and answer buyers. Prices run from $5 to $500, with a 20% fee per sale and no listing or monthly fees. A person reviews every listing, and packages are malware-scanned and fingerprinted.
- [Microsoft Agent Skills](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/microsoft-agent-skills.html) (added 2026-11-27): Microsoft Agent Skills is an MIT collection of skills, custom agents, AGENTS.md templates and MCP configuration for coding agents that use Azure SDKs and Microsoft AI Foundry. The README says the repo is still in progress and that the skill explorer lists 175 skills. Install is npx skills add microsoft/skills. The explorer at https://microsoft.github.io/skills/ returned HTTP 200 on 27 Nov 2026. GitHub microsoft/skills showed 3,255 stars and 376 forks that day.
- [Agent Toolkit for AWS](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agent-toolkit-for-aws.html) (added 2026-11-27): The Agent Toolkit for AWS gives coding agents tools, knowledge and guardrails for building on AWS. The README says it works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin, Kiro and fx, and that the AWS CLI command is aws configure agent-toolkit. The CLI guide at that docs URL returned HTTP 200 on 27 Nov 2026. Plugins also install from Anthropic's Claude Code marketplace, including an aws-core plugin. GitHub aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws recorded Apache-2.0, 3,594 stars and 487 forks on 27 Nov 2026. The README did not list a separate toolkit price.
- [Laravel Boost](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/laravel-boost.html) (added 2026-11-27): Laravel Boost is an MIT package that gives a coding agent Laravel-specific context so the code it writes matches a Laravel app. The README points documentation at the Laravel site. That docs page returned HTTP 200 on 27 Nov 2026 at https://laravel.com/framework/docs/13.x/boost. Release v2.10.4 was published 29 Oct 2026 and adds a command to re-index rules. GitHub laravel/boost showed 3,697 stars and 393 forks on 27 Nov 2026.
- [OpenGame](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/opengame.html) (added 2026-11-27): OpenGame is an Apache-2.0 game studio for coding agents. The README calls it a full-stack agent that remixes, restyles, tests and publishes playable 3D, anime, pixel and vertical mini-games, and it says the repo includes 25 playable templates and 22 local agents. GitHub nexu-io/opengame showed 1,799 stars and 295 forks on 27 Nov 2026. The repo has no homepage of its own. It is a different repository from nexu-io/html-video and nexu-io/html-anything.
- [Simlock](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/simlock.html) (added 2026-11-27): Simlock leases iOS simulators, Android emulators and enrolled phones to coding agents so two agents do not use the same device at once. The site on 27 Nov 2026 says it is free and open source, that one Mac is enough to start, and that more machines can sit behind a gateway. Install is npm i -g simlock. Release v0.9.0, published 26 Nov 2026, requires agent-device 0.21.40 or later on every worker. This listing is Simlock, not Agent Device. GitHub callstackincubator/simlock recorded MIT, 727 stars and 42 forks on 27 Nov 2026.
- [Freebuff](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/freebuff.html) (added 2026-11-27): Freebuff is an Apache-2.0 coding agent from Codebuff. The README says there is no subscription, no credits and no API key, and that text ads pay for the included models. It names four products: a desktop app that runs agents locally, a CLI, a web builder for full-stack apps, and a cloud runner for GitHub repositories. GitHub CodebuffAI/freebuff showed 14,336 stars and 1,551 forks on 27 Nov 2026.
- [Kaeso](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/kaeso.html) (added 2026-11-27): Kaeso is a self-hosted AI gateway in Rust. The homepage on 27 Nov 2026 says apps call one API while provider keys stay on the gateway, encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a master key you hold, and that a hard budget can refuse a request before any provider is called. The page showed version 0.7.4 and said that release stops a CPU-heavy merge of a tool schema after 4,096 schemas. Docs include an MCP portal at https://docs.kaeso.app/concepts/mcp-portal. GitHub logicplanes/kaeso recorded MIT, 62 stars and 3 forks on 27 Nov 2026. The homepage sample prices are pass-through provider rates in the demo console, not a Kaeso subscription.
- [Pepys](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/pepys.html) (added 2026-11-27): Pepys Transcribe turns audio and video into timestamped text, and ships a hosted MCP server so an agent can transcribe on its own. The MCP docs on 27 Nov 2026 say sign-in is OAuth, and the server is listed in Claude's connector directory. A connection without a sign-in is refused. The pricing page said the first 60 minutes are free with no card. After that, audio is $1.25 an hour on purchases under $20, $1.00 an hour from $20, and $0.85 an hour from $85. One credit is one minute, credits do not expire, and speaker labels use 1.5 credits a minute. The docs also name a separate package you can run locally. GitHub recorded that package as MIT, with 0 stars and 0 forks on 27 Nov 2026.
- [MotifDeck](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/motifdeck.html) (added 2026-11-27): MotifDeck makes 2D game characters, sprites and short animations, then exports sprite sheets. The pricing page on 27 Nov 2026 listed Free at $0 with 60 welcome credits that do not expire. Starter was $19 a month for 1,500 credits, Creator $39 for 3,600, Pro $79 for 8,500 and Studio $159 for 20,000. Annual billing was shown as 25% less. The page says the credit cost is shown before a run. Free includes a limited number of tool runs. This is a game-art workspace, not a general image chat.
- [We0](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/we0.html) (added 2026-11-27): We0 generates a website or app with payments, login and an admin, using a multi-agent build and a visual canvas. The pricing page on 27 Nov 2026 listed Free at $0 with one full generation and 100 credits on sign-up. Plus was shown as $29 crossed out and $18 a month, with 888 credits. Pro was shown as $286 crossed out and $240 a year, with 12,888 credits. The page said one project usually costs about 60 to 150 credits, a standard step 3 to 6 credits and a complex step 6 to 20. The public content index is linked from that page at https://we0.ai/llms.txt.
- [KOMA](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/koma.html) (added 2026-11-27): KOMA, from Alchemint, turns a line, a script or reference media into a storyboard and a video, and the homepage also describes a CLI that tells a local AI which shots to move or generate. ## Launches and status

- [How AgentScout started](https://agentscouthq.com/how-it-started.html): founder-run, mostly automated with AI agents. @clampdown19 (m lk) makes the calls.
- [Weekly launch board](https://agentscouthq.com/launches/): tools added each ISO week (Pacific), with server-side upvotes.
- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): up, down, and not-yet-checked counts. Updated daily, around 7 AM PT.
- The $99 weekly sponsorship includes submissions to about 25 other AI directories, with a report of the links. Refunds: https://agentscouthq.com/refunds.html
- Fast-Track ($15) includes: Submitted to Google via sitemap the same day, and pinged to Bing and IndexNow.

## Community Grok Bot templates

- [PR Reviewer](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-pr-reviewer): Reviews pull requests for risk, missing tests, and thin context so review starts with the scary diff. Leads with what can break, what is untested.
- [Agent Looper](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-agent-looper): You say what to build and how to know it's done. It keeps a coding agent working on your computer until that check passes.
- [Examiner](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-examiner): Maintain a reliable timeline of important changes so you can reconstruct what happened when something later goes wrong. Isolated: talk only to you.
- [AI Harness Assistant](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ai-harness-assistant): Keeps the AI coding tools you already have, like Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Cursor, current on your Windows, Mac, and Linux machines.
- [GreenBuild](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-greenbuild): A senior QA and test-automation lead for testers and dev teams. It turns requirements into test plans and triages flaky tests.
- [UI/UX/Designer. Product Engineer 1000x](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-1000x-product-engineer): World-class product engineer for mobile and desktop web. Ships Convex + TanStack + React end to end. Simple, intuitive UI with real taste.
- [illo](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-illo): Editorial illustration bot that uses the illo skill (tmchow/illo-skill) to turn ideas, posts, and announcements into mascot-led images on Grok Bot.
- [Design Expert](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-design-expert): A product design lead that keeps AI-built UIs honest.
- [Fabrication](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-fabrication): Takes your parts from CAD design to a finished 3D print. It checks fit, flat bed faces and hole sizes, and shows previews.
- [Churn retention manager](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-churn-retention-manager): Catches churn before it lands, offers a real alternative, and reports why people left. For businesses saving cancellations and failed payments.
- [Echo](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-echo): Turns a customer call into slides from customer context. What we heard, next steps, project initiatives, or all of the above.
- [Events](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-events): A market and pop-up inventory desk for small sellers. It builds pack lists before a show and logs what sold afterward.
- [Go Direct](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-go-direct): Skip the press. Lulu helps founders tell their story straight to the 50 to 500 people who actually matter: investors, early customers, future hires.
- [LinkedIn Desk](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-linkedin-desk): LinkedIn Desk helps you keep network quality high without living in LinkedIn, by reviewing connection requests and LinkedIn invitations.
- [Meeting to Money](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-sumosign): Turns a sales meeting into a priced proposal, a signed go-ahead, an invoice, and payment chase. You approve every send. For freelancers and small agencies.
- [DOGE (Department of Grok Efficiency)](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-chief-of-staff-avid): A Grok Bot whose only job is to audit your other bots and routines, flag what to cut or merge, and find bottlenecks.
- [Watchdog](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-watchdog): On first install, scans email once as soon as Gmail is ready, then weekly for receipts, renewals, and trials.
- [AIUsageBot](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ai-usage-meter): Interviews you about which AI subscriptions to track and where leftover lives (local CLIs, apps), then pings remaining % as it drops.
- [SlowBooks Cutover](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-slowbooks-cutover): Migrate one QuickBooks Desktop company into SlowBooks via Conductor (read-only), then prove Trial Balance and spot-check P&L.
- [Newsletter Cleanup](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-newsletter-cleanup): Audits Gmail newsletters (last 6 months), builds a three-bucket review.html, then unsubscribes only what you approve. Never deletes mail.
- [Bot inbox](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-bot-inbox): A weekday unread digest for Grok Bots. Lists bots and group chats with new activity, one line each. Type scan anytime.
- [Dewey](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-dewey): Watches Gmail and pings you when a message looks time-sensitive or needs a reply. Reads freely; never sends, replies, or trashes mail unless you ask.
- [Harper](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-harper): An executive assistant for email, calendar, and texting. It triages your inbox, schedules people, protects deep-work time.
- [Backpack](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-backpack): Reads school and activity emails you don't have time for and turns them into calendar events, reminders, and a weekly family plan.
- [BFCM Email Planner](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-bfcm-email-planner): Plans your full Black Friday / Cyber Monday email and SMS calendar: sends, segments, offer angles, subject lines.
- [Be Happier](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-be-happier): Looks at your email and calendar each week, then suggests 3 concrete things that would make you happier. Protects existing life, does not add new habits.
- [Chef](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-chef): A home-cooking helper that adapts to the country you live in: seasonal produce, local dishes, holidays, and grocers where you are.
- [Interview Prep](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-interview-prep): Interview prep for any topic. Pick the topic and level, then climb with examples, running code, and quizzes until it feels interview-ready.
- [Canvas](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-canvas): Keeps an eye on a student's Canvas LMS: daily reminders of what's due, overdue or missing, assignment briefs and rubrics, and pass-mark math.
- [EG4 Monitor](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-eg4-monitor): Watches your EG4 solar and battery system on EG4 Monitor Center and sends you a nightly report with estimated savings, all read-only.
- [Human Copywriter](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-human-copywriter): A human-voice rewrite desk for email, posts, blogs, DMs, landing-page bodies, and PR. American English by default.
